title: EventEmailSettingsLogoSettingsRequest
description: Request body for POST /organizations/{organizationId}/event-email-settings/{context}/logo-settings. context is specified in the URL path, not in this body.

logoUrl.description: Logo image URL to apply to this context (both modes). Optional; omitting or nulling clears the context-level logo URL (and any nested mode-level values) independently of logoWidth. No format validation is applied.

logoWidth.description: Logo display width to apply to this context (both modes), as a percentage string (e.g. "50%"). Optional; omitting or nulling clears the context-level logo width (and any nested mode-level values) independently of logoUrl. No format validation is enforced server-side despite this expected convention.
